Yet outside of San Antonio, Vassell seems like an afterthought among the names populating a star-studded starting lineup with two All-Stars in Wembanyama and Fox and a pair of guards in Castle and Harper destined for plenty of All-Star nods in the future. "I feel like that's kind of been my whole life," Vassell told ESPN. "I wasn't a five-star [recruit], wasn't one of the big names. So, I've worked my way for everything, and I've never really cared about what anybody else has to say. I don't worry about the headlines. I don't worry about points. It's just a matter of how I can impact the team. It's been in many different ways. And I think that helped me so much for where I'm at today."
